defects.description: Negative starts are clamped to zero instead of translated from the current end.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { Journal } from "./src/index.js"; const j = new Journal(); j.append(["a","b"]); j.append(["c","d","e"]); console.log(JSON.stringify(j.window(-3,5)));'

defects.why_missed: Forward windows never translate tail-relative bounds; a first test with both bounds negative returns empty before the incorrect start becomes observable.
